
Start a local HTTP service

$ curl --fail --silent --show-error http://127.0.0.1:58693/health
{"status":"ok"}
Solve zlib for Linux and inspect the result

$ curl --fail --silent --show-error -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"specs":["zlib"],"channels":["conda-forge"],"platforms":["linux-64"]}' http://127.0.0.1:58693/resolve > result.json

$ jq '[.[] | {platform, error, packages: [.packages[].name]}]' result.json
[
  {
    "platform": "linux-64",
    "error": null,
    "packages": [
      "libzlib",
      "zlib"
    ]
  }
]

Export a lock and retrieve its exact retained bytes

$ curl --fail --silent --show-error --dump-header headers.txt 'http://127.0.0.1:58693/resolve?spec=zlib&channel=conda-forge&platform=linux-64&format=pixi-lock-v6' > pixi.lock

$ curl --fail --silent --show-error http://127.0.0.1:58693/r/fabbd7314fc9bc0d89e9f167b9a17ec130f2d7edeb2cb20bfba7ff519e03ae60 > retained.lock

$ cmp pixi.lock retained.lock

The retrieved lock is byte-for-byte identical
